odel, size or specification without prior written approval of the competent authority. 14. Risk & Cost: In case of failure to supply conforming material within the stipulated period, action sh all be taken as per applicable GeM/Government procurement terms and conditions. 16. Price: The quoted price shall include all costs necessary for complete delivery of the material at the consignee's location, except components specifically required to be quoted separately in the GeM B id. 17. Quantity: The purchaser reserves the right to accept the ordered quantity as per the GeM Contract . No additional quantity shall be supplied without authorization. 18. Documents: The successful bidder shall submit all documents/certificates required under the GeM Bid, including invoice, warranty certificate, test certificate and other applicable documents along wit h the supply. 19.
